sources.summary: I've been using Gemini to live chat in Afrikaans and do impromptu Afrikaans grammar lessons during my solo drives around town. It is phenomenal at speaking the language - like, it really shocks my family members when they hear it. This is probably the most joy I get from any of my usages of LLMs/AIs. It's been really, really nice getting to speak my language regularly again. =) So, I'm excited about this release and live chat getting better. I also hope the other frontier labs pick up niche lang
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 用户分享开车时用 Gemini 3.8 Live 以 Afrikaans 实时聊天、即兴上语法课，家人听到都震惊；也有人让它用 Catalan 讲 The Hobbit 哄女儿睡前听。

sources.title: Perplexity 自研 CobbleDB 替代 AWS DynamoDB，每年最多可节省一亿美元 / We built a replacement for AWS DynamoDB， a key-value database for fast web content fetches. This was…
sources.title_zh: Perplexity 自研 CobbleDB 替代 AWS DynamoDB，每年最多可节省一亿美元
sources.title_en: We built a replacement for AWS DynamoDB， a key-value database for fast web content fetches. This was…

sources.summary: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas 宣布自研键值数据库 CobbleDB，替代 AWS DynamoDB 用于快速网页内容抓取，迁移后每年最多可节省一亿美元。该项目由两名工程师和数百个持续运行的 Computer 智能体在两个月内完成核心基础设施，官方研究称热存储批次读取延迟较 DynamoDB 全分布下降约 5 倍（P50 从 31.4ms 降至 5.60ms）。
